files.reason: CP3's confounded-design grader v4: a new copy of the first study's classifier (confounded_refusal.py:46-162) with F-08's fixes: a question-form or embedded-question/conditional caution that would read asserted reads silent (its docstring's under-report rule), the broad nuisance term 'run' narrowed to 'sequencing run' and the broad condition term 'design' dropped; the helpers it called from evals/stated_count.py (NEGATION_SCOPE, normalise, sentences, negation_scope and the three patterns negation_scope reads, stated_count.py:614-660 and 822-835) re-implemented here, since stated_count is neither an allowed copy source nor pinned (glitch-f3's pick over widening ALLOWED_SOURCES); the transcript loader, the turn-8 answer index, the CLI and the case replay dropped; the agent's words read through transcript_view and forbidden actions through graders/endstate.py (via new_tasks.Take); the 'reason' key of each sentence's audit renamed 'rule' (a swept raw name). Only the prompted version; it emits no flagged-then-acted. Fold 2 (review round 2, glitch-f3's rulings of 8 Oct 2026 under Javier's delegation): a named departure from F-08's copy, the first study's NEGATIONS widened with four word-bound negations ('rather than', 'instead of', 'avoid' with its inflections, 'free from'), because each over-reported against the study's own rule that the grader never credits a claim the agent did not make; and human-sample flags by rule (an F-08 rule silenced a stem sentence and the reply reads silent) and for two named residuals (a negation cut off by a dash inside a compound, a preventive 'against'). The first study's file is never edited. Fold 3 (review round 3, glitch-f3's rulings of 8 Oct 2026 under Javier's delegation): the scope each word set is read over: the first study's thirteen negations over the frozen clause-chain scope, exactly as there; the four added ones only in the stem's own clause, so an added word in a matrix clause set off by a comma does not deny an assertion in a subordinate one. The departure's measured cost, wrong labels against the reviewers' reader labels over 133 replies (that row set only) (the 87 fixture rows of rounds 1 and 2 plus round 3's 46), per half: the first study's negations only, positive 17 and control 22; the Fold 2 head (d1839653, the added words over the chain), positive 23 and control 14; this head, positive 18 and control 14. Two more human-sample flags for named residuals: an added negation right after 'far from' (a double negation), and an asserted sentence holding 'none', 'nothing', 'neither' or 'zero' (it flags 0 of 68 right positive-half replies). Fold 4 (review round 4, the lane lead's recommendation approved by Javier as 'w3c: fold and close', 8 Oct 2026; W3C4-1, W3C4-4): the Fold 3 claim corrected: the own clause cuts only at a frozen clause boundary, never at a subordinator, so when no comma precedes the subordinator an added word in a matrix clause can still deny a real assertion in the subordinate clause ('I'd avoid running the test because condition is confounded with lane.'); measured on round 4's twelve comma-less matrix-clause replies, 11 of 12 are mislabelled by the added words (the twelfth by the first study's inherited 'n't'), beside the 133-row cost of positive 18 and control 14, which holds over that row set only. No reading changes: one more human-sample flag, SUBORDINATED_DENIALS (a sentence denied by an added negation with a subordinator between it and the stem in the stem's own clause), which flags 0 of the 133 fixture rows, all 11 added-caused comma-less replies and the two complement-'that' own-clause ones (O13, O22), at a cost of 6 right control-half denials sampled. No label moves. Pre-freeze review 1, m8 (lane pf1-l1-freeze-gates; the copy-record rule of its review folds of 25 Oct 2026): this copy is a near-rewrite of its source. The commits that changed it after its copy commit and before this lane's review folds, oldest first: 26987a3744b9, 9f8470915eae, bed488a8feb8, 9dd2aa9dcf95, 6bef073a7d85, 921d15229809.
